HISTORY: on 2026-11-19 I read the count per root and said so in loop/sign.py; the push was rejected (refutation_reproduced, 94470bb: a two-target job made 6 runs and reported success). The page's words are the job's, and since 2026-11-20 the code follows them: the runs are counted in one list per yaz job (loop.job run), every root signer of the job counts in it, the runs that signed too (loop.sign 'The job's count'). WHAT THE PAGE'S COUNT THEN MEANS, still open for the operator: (1) every root needs one successful run, so a job of more than 3 served targets cannot sign its fourth root even when no run fails: the fourth target is a hard stop (Rekor'a yazilamama) with no run made; (2) with two targets the two roots share one spare run: a first root signed on its third run leaves the second none, and the second target is a hard stop after the first was written.
